word: a slip of the tongue / pen

examples.en: I didn't mean to insult her; it was just a slip of the tongue.
examples.zh: 我無意侮辱她；那只是口誤。

examples.en: His slip of the pen caused a misunderstanding in the contract.
examples.zh: 他的筆誤導致了合約上的誤會。

examples.en: Please forgive my slip of the tongue during the presentation.
examples.zh: 請原諒我在簡報時的口誤。

examples.en: A slip of the pen can sometimes have serious legal consequences.
examples.zh: 筆誤有時會產生嚴重的法律後果。

examples.en: She quickly apologized for her slip of the tongue.
examples.zh: 她為自己的口誤迅速道了歉。

examples.en: We sat on a wooden bench in the park to rest.
examples.zh: 我們坐在公園的木長凳上休息。

examples.en: The coach benched his best player due to an injury.
examples.zh: 教練因為受傷而讓最好的球員坐冷板凳。

examples.en: There is a stone bench under the large oak tree.
examples.zh: 大橡樹下有一張石長凳。

examples.en: She left her jacket on the park bench.
examples.zh: 她把外套忘在了公園長凳上。

examples.en: The old man feeds the pigeons from his favorite bench every morning.
examples.zh: 老人每天早上都在他最喜歡的長凳上餵鴿子。

examples.en: Many blue-collar workers are demanding better working conditions.
examples.zh: 許多藍領階級要求更好的工作條件。

examples.en: He is proud of his blue-collar background and hard work.
examples.zh: 他為自己的藍領背景和辛勤工作感到自豪。

examples.en: The town's economy relies heavily on blue-collar jobs in manufacturing.
examples.zh: 這個城鎮的經濟很大程度上依賴於製造業的藍領工作。

examples.en: Blue-collar employees often face higher risks of workplace injuries.
examples.zh: 藍領員工通常面臨較高的工傷風險。

examples.en: My father spent his entire life doing blue-collar work in a factory.
examples.zh: 我父親一輩子都在工廠做藍領工作。

examples.en: The caterpillar is about three centimeters long.
examples.zh: 這條毛毛蟲大約三公分長。

examples.en: Please move the painting a few centimeters to the left.
examples.zh: 請把畫向左移幾公分。

examples.en: A centimeter is a unit of length in the metric system.
examples.zh: 公分是公制中的長度單位。

examples.en: The water level rose by several centimeters after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨過後水位上升了幾公分。

examples.en: She is only a few centimeters taller than her younger sister.
examples.zh: 她只比她妹妹高幾公分。

examples.en: He wore a shirt with a stiff white collar.
examples.zh: 他穿著一件有硬白領的襯衫。

examples.en: The dog managed to slip out of its collar and run away.
examples.zh: 那隻狗成功掙脫了項圈跑掉了。

examples.en: Please turn down your collar; it looks messy.
examples.zh: 請把你的衣領翻下來；看起來很亂。

examples.en: She bought a leather collar with a silver tag for her new puppy.
examples.zh: 她為新小狗買了一個帶有銀色吊牌的皮項圈。

examples.en: The police collared the thief before he could escape the building.
examples.zh: 警察在小偷逃出大樓前逮捕了他。

examples.en: I bought a chocolate doughnut and a cup of coffee for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我買了一個巧克力甜甜圈和一杯咖啡當早餐。

examples.en: The bakery is famous for its freshly baked doughnuts.
examples.zh: 這家麵包店以其剛出爐的甜甜圈聞名。

examples.en: He took a bite of the sugary doughnut and smiled.
examples.zh: 他咬了一口撒滿糖的甜甜圈，笑了起來。

examples.en: Eating too many doughnuts can lead to weight gain.
examples.zh: 吃太多甜甜圈會導致體重增加。

examples.en: They sell doughnuts with various fillings, like strawberry and custard.
examples.zh: 他們賣各種餡料的甜甜圈，像是草莓和卡士達。

examples.en: Please use a pencil so you can erase any mistakes easily.
examples.zh: 請使用鉛筆，這樣你可以輕易擦掉錯誤。

examples.en: He tried to erase the painful memories from his mind.
examples.zh: 他試圖將痛苦的記憶從腦海中抹去。

examples.en: The teacher erased the notes on the blackboard after the class.
examples.zh: 老師下課後擦掉了黑板上的筆記。

examples.en: Make sure you don't accidentally erase all the important files on your computer.
examples.zh: 確保你不會意外刪除電腦上所有重要的檔案。

examples.en: Time cannot erase the impact she had on my life.
examples.zh: 時間無法抹滅她對我人生的影響。

meaning: 昂貴的、豪華的；花俏精緻的、酷炫的；幻想；喜歡 (男女之間的)

examples.en: They had dinner at a fancy restaurant to celebrate their anniversary.
examples.zh: 他們在一家高級餐廳吃晚餐慶祝紀念日。

examples.en: I don't fancy going out tonight; I'd rather stay home.
examples.zh: 我今晚不想出門；我寧願待在家。

examples.en: She was wearing a very fancy dress at the party.
examples.zh: 她在派對上穿著一件非常華麗的洋裝。

examples.en: Do you fancy a cup of tea before we start working?
examples.zh: 我們開始工作前你想喝杯茶嗎？

examples.en: He bought a fancy new sports car with his bonus.
examples.zh: 他用獎金買了一輛酷炫的新跑車。

examples.en: A flock of birds flew across the sunset sky.
examples.zh: 一群鳥飛過日落的天空。

examples.en: Tourists flock to the island every summer for its beautiful beaches.
examples.zh: 每年夏天遊客成群結隊來到這座島嶼，因為這裡有美麗的海灘。

examples.en: The shepherd guided his flock of sheep back to the barn.
examples.zh: 牧羊人引導他的羊群回到穀倉。

examples.en: Thousands of fans flocked to the stadium to see the pop star.
examples.zh: 成千上萬的粉絲湧入體育場看這位流行巨星。

examples.en: They saw a flock of geese resting near the lake.
examples.zh: 他們看到一群鵝在湖邊休息。

examples.en: The local grocer knows most of his customers by name.
examples.zh: 當地的雜貨商能叫出大部分顧客的名字。

examples.en: My grandfather worked as a grocer for over forty years.
examples.zh: 我祖父做了四十多年的雜貨商。

examples.en: The grocer arranged the fresh vegetables neatly on the shelves.
examples.zh: 雜貨商將新鮮蔬菜整齊地擺放在架子上。

examples.en: We buy our daily supplies from the grocer at the corner.
examples.zh: 我們向轉角的雜貨商購買日常用品。

examples.en: The grocer warned us that the price of eggs would rise soon.
examples.zh: 雜貨商警告我們雞蛋的價格很快就會上漲。

examples.en: I need to buy some groceries for dinner tonight.
examples.zh: 我需要買些雜貨來做今晚的晚餐。

examples.en: She spent fifty dollars on groceries at the supermarket.
examples.zh: 她在超市花了五十美元買雜貨。

examples.en: Carrying heavy bags of groceries up the stairs is exhausting.
examples.zh: 提著沉重的雜貨袋上樓梯很累人。

examples.en: They usually do their grocery shopping on Saturday mornings.
examples.zh: 他們通常在星期六早上採買雜貨。

examples.en: The delivery boy left the groceries at our front door.
examples.zh: 外送員把雜貨留在了我們的前門。

examples.en: There is a small grocery store just down the street.
examples.zh: 沿著這條街往下走有一家小雜貨店。

examples.en: He stopped by the grocery store to pick up some milk.
examples.zh: 他順路去雜貨店買些牛奶。

examples.en: The grocery store is open 24 hours a day for your convenience.
examples.zh: 為了您的方便，這家雜貨店24小時營業。

examples.en: She works part-time as a cashier at a local grocery store.
examples.zh: 她在當地的一家雜貨店兼職當收銀員。

examples.en: They decided to open a new grocery store in the neighborhood.
examples.zh: 他們決定在附近開一家新的雜貨店。

meaning: 體育館；健身房；體育、體操（在體育館內進行的體育活動）

examples.en: The graduation ceremony will be held in the school gymnasium.
examples.zh: 畢業典禮將在學校體育館舉行。

examples.en: Students gather in the gymnasium every morning for assembly.
examples.zh: 學生每天早上在體育館集合開朝會。

examples.en: The new gymnasium features a modern basketball court and a swimming pool.
examples.zh: 新體育館設有現代化的籃球場和游泳池。

examples.en: He spends an hour in the gymnasium lifting weights after work.
examples.zh: 他下班後在健身房花一小時舉重。

examples.en: During the storm, the gymnasium served as a temporary shelter.
examples.zh: 風暴期間，體育館被當作臨時避難所。

examples.en: She took pity on the stray cat and brought it home.
examples.zh: 她可憐那隻流浪貓並把它帶回家。

examples.en: The judge took pity on the young offender and gave him a lighter sentence.
examples.zh: 法官同情這名年輕的罪犯，判了他較輕的刑罰。

examples.en: Please have pity on the homeless people in this freezing weather.
examples.zh: 在這種嚴寒天氣裡，請同情一下無家可歸的人。

examples.en: He refused to ask for help because he didn't want anyone to take pity on him.
examples.zh: 他拒絕尋求幫助，因為他不想讓任何人同情他。

examples.en: Taking pity on the lost child, the police officer bought him an ice cream.
examples.zh: 警察同情這個迷路的孩子，給他買了一個冰淇淋。

meaning: 頭部、指揮官、領導者；朝~方向前進；領導、帶頭

examples.en: He nodded his head to show that he agreed with me.
examples.zh: 他點點頭表示同意我的看法。

examples.en: She was appointed as the head of the marketing department.
examples.zh: 她被任命為行銷部門的主管。

examples.en: They decided to head south for the winter to escape the cold.
examples.zh: 他們決定往南走過冬以避寒。

examples.en: The principal will head the committee responsible for the new curriculum.
examples.zh: 校長將領導負責新課程的委員會。

examples.en: Make sure to protect your head when you ride a motorcycle.
examples.zh: 騎機車時務必保護好你的頭部。

examples.en: Please write the main topic under the bold heading.
examples.zh: 請將主旨寫在粗體標題下方。

examples.en: The chapter has a short heading that summarizes its content.
examples.zh: 這一章有一個簡短的標題來總結其內容。

examples.en: She looked for her name under the heading 'Accepted Candidates'.
examples.zh: 她在「錄取名單」的標題下尋找自己的名字。

examples.en: Each paragraph should have a clear heading to guide the reader.
examples.zh: 每個段落都應該有一個清晰的標題來引導讀者。

examples.en: He quickly scanned the headings in the report before the meeting.
examples.zh: 開會前他快速瀏覽了報告中的標題。

examples.en: The news of the royal wedding dominated the front-page headline.
examples.zh: 皇家婚禮的新聞占據了頭版頭條。

examples.en: She glanced at the headline of the newspaper but didn't read the article.
examples.zh: 她瞥了一眼報紙的頭條，但沒有閱讀文章。

examples.en: His shocking statement immediately made headlines around the world.
examples.zh: 他令人震驚的聲明立刻成為全世界的頭條新聞。

examples.en: The editor decided to change the headline to make it more catchy.
examples.zh: 編輯決定更改頭條，使其更吸引人。

examples.en: Yesterday's headline about the economic crisis worried many investors.
examples.zh: 昨天關於經濟危機的頭條新聞讓許多投資者感到擔憂。

examples.en: You must wear a helmet when riding a bicycle for safety.
examples.zh: 為了安全起見，騎自行車時必須戴安全帽。

examples.en: The construction worker took off his yellow helmet to wipe his sweat.
examples.zh: 建築工人摘下黃色安全帽擦汗。

examples.en: The helmet protected his head during the severe crash.
examples.zh: 在嚴重的車禍中，安全帽保護了他的頭部。

examples.en: She strapped her helmet on tightly before climbing the rock wall.
examples.zh: 在攀岩之前，她緊緊繫好安全帽的帶子。

examples.en: Motorcycle helmets come in various designs and colors.
examples.zh: 機車安全帽有各種設計和顏色。

examples.en: As a freshman living in the dorm, he often felt homesick.
examples.zh: 作為一個住在宿舍的大一新生，他經常想家。

examples.en: Looking at old family photos made her incredibly homesick.
examples.zh: 看著舊家庭照片讓她無比思鄉。

examples.en: The exchange student burst into tears because she was too homesick.
examples.zh: 這名交換學生因為太想家而哭了出來。

examples.en: Calling her parents every weekend helps ease her homesick feelings.
examples.zh: 每週末打電話給父母有助於緩解她思鄉的情緒。

examples.en: It is completely normal to feel homesick when you first study abroad.
examples.zh: 剛出國留學時感到想家是完全正常的。

examples.en: He returned to his hometown after working in the city for ten years.
examples.zh: 在城市工作十年後，他回到了故鄉。

examples.en: My hometown is famous for its delicious street food and night markets.
examples.zh: 我的故鄉以美味的街頭小吃和夜市而聞名。

examples.en: She always speaks proudly of her small, peaceful hometown.
examples.zh: 她總是自豪地談論她那寧靜的小故鄉。

examples.en: The mayor gave a speech to celebrate the history of their hometown.
examples.zh: 市長發表演說慶祝他們故鄉的歷史。

examples.en: Many young people leave their hometowns to seek better opportunities.
examples.zh: 許多年輕人離開故鄉尋求更好的機會。

examples.en: Due to the rain, the event was moved to an indoor stadium.
examples.zh: 因為下雨，活動移至室內體育館舉行。

examples.en: Indoor plants can improve the air quality in your home.
examples.zh: 室內植物可以改善你家中的空氣品質。

examples.en: Swimming in an indoor pool is perfect for winter exercises.
examples.zh: 在室內游泳池游泳非常適合冬季運動。

examples.en: They set up an indoor playground for the children to enjoy.
examples.zh: 他們為孩子們建立了一個室內遊樂場。

examples.en: Indoor lighting plays a crucial role in interior design.
examples.zh: 室內照明在室內設計中扮演著至關重要的角色。

examples.en: Let's stay indoors today since it's freezing outside.
examples.zh: 外面太冷了，我們今天就待在室內吧。

examples.en: The dog was kept indoors during the fireworks display.
examples.zh: 放煙火時，那隻狗被關在室內。

examples.en: It started pouring, so we quickly ran indoors.
examples.zh: 開始傾盆大雨了，所以我們趕快跑進室內。

examples.en: Most of the children prefer playing video games indoors to playing outside.
examples.zh: 大多數孩子寧願在室內玩電動遊戲也不願在外面玩。

examples.en: Please leave your wet umbrella near the door when you come indoors.
examples.zh: 進來室內時，請把濕雨傘放在門口附近。

examples.en: He felt jealous when he saw his girlfriend talking to another man.
examples.zh: 當他看到女友和另一個男人說話時，他感到嫉妒。

examples.en: She is naturally jealous of her sister's success and talent.
examples.zh: 她天生嫉妒姊姊的成功和才華。

examples.en: Don't be jealous of others; focus on your own goals.
examples.zh: 不要嫉妒別人；專注於你自己的目標。

examples.en: His jealous remarks revealed his true feelings about the promotion.
examples.zh: 他嫉妒的言辭透露了他對升職的真實感受。

examples.en: A jealous attitude can ruin a perfectly good relationship.
examples.zh: 嫉妒的態度可能會毀掉一段美好的關係。

examples.en: I made a peanut butter and jelly sandwich for lunch.
examples.zh: 我做了一個花生醬果凍三明治當午餐。

examples.en: The children love eating fruit jelly as a dessert.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡吃水果果凍當甜點。

examples.en: She bought a jar of strawberry jelly from the supermarket.
examples.zh: 她從超市買了一罐草莓果醬。

examples.en: His legs felt like jelly after the rigorous marathon.
examples.zh: 跑完嚴格的馬拉松後，他的腿軟得像果凍。

examples.en: The baker spread some jelly over the surface of the cake.
examples.zh: 麵包師傅在蛋糕表面塗了一些果醬。

examples.en: The queen wore a crown decorated with sparkling jewels.
examples.zh: 女王戴著一頂裝飾著閃亮寶石的皇冠。

examples.en: This antique vase is the crown jewel of the museum's collection.
examples.zh: 這個古董花瓶是博物館收藏中的瑰寶。

examples.en: Thieves broke into the shop and stole several precious jewels.
examples.zh: 小偷闖入商店並偷走了幾件珍貴的首飾。

examples.en: She kept a hidden jewel in a small wooden box.
examples.zh: 她把一顆隱藏的寶石放在一個小木盒裡。

examples.en: He is highly valued by the company and considered a real jewel.
examples.zh: 他深受公司重視，被認為是真正的人才（瑰寶）。

examples.en: She inherited a large collection of gold and silver jewelry.
examples.zh: 她繼承了一大批金銀珠寶。

examples.en: The jewelry store on the corner was robbed last night.
examples.zh: 轉角那家珠寶店昨晚被搶劫了。

examples.en: He bought her a piece of expensive jewelry for their anniversary.
examples.zh: 他買了一件昂貴的珠寶給她作為紀念日禮物。

examples.en: Please store all your valuable jewelry in the hotel safe.
examples.zh: 請將您所有貴重的珠寶存放在飯店保險箱中。

examples.en: Making handmade jewelry has become her new favorite hobby.
examples.zh: 製作手工珠寶成了她最新的愛好。

examples.en: The garage is full of old junk that we need to throw away.
examples.zh: 車庫裡滿是我們需要丟掉的舊垃圾。

examples.en: He spent the weekend clearing out the junk from the attic.
examples.zh: 他花了整個週末清理閣樓裡的沒用東西。

examples.en: Don't believe what you read in that magazine; it's mostly junk.
examples.zh: 別相信你在那本雜誌上讀到的東西；大部分都是廢話。

examples.en: I found some valuable antiques hidden among the junk at the flea market.
examples.zh: 我在跳蚤市場的破爛中發現了一些有價值的古董。

examples.en: He decided to sell his junk car to a scrap yard.
examples.zh: 他決定把他的報廢老爺車賣給廢料場。

examples.en: Eating too much junk food can lead to health problems like obesity.
examples.zh: 吃太多垃圾食品會導致肥胖等健康問題。

examples.en: Parents should limit the amount of junk food their children consume.
examples.zh: 父母應該限制孩子攝取的垃圾食品數量。

examples.en: She decided to cut out junk food and start eating healthy meals.
examples.zh: 她決定戒掉垃圾食品，開始吃健康的餐點。

examples.en: Chips, soda, and candy are classic examples of junk food.
examples.zh: 洋芋片、汽水和糖果是垃圾食品的典型例子。

examples.en: He grabbed some junk food from the convenience store on his way home.
examples.zh: 他在回家的路上從便利商店買了一些垃圾食品。

examples.en: She had to undergo surgery to remove a stone from her kidney.
examples.zh: 她必須接受手術取出腎臟裡的結石。

examples.en: Drinking plenty of water is essential for maintaining healthy kidneys.
examples.zh: 喝大量的水對維持健康的腎臟至關重要。

examples.en: He generously donated a kidney to save his brother's life.
examples.zh: 他慷慨地捐出一個腎臟來拯救他兄弟的生命。

examples.en: Kidney failure can be a life-threatening condition if left untreated.
examples.zh: 如果不加以治療，腎衰竭可能是危及生命的疾病。

examples.en: The doctor ordered a blood test to check the patient's kidney function.
examples.zh: 醫生要求驗血以檢查患者的腎功能。

examples.en: The next gas station is about ten kilometers away.
examples.zh: 下一個加油站大約在十公里外。

examples.en: He runs five kilometers every morning to stay fit.
examples.zh: 他每天早上跑五公里以保持健康。

examples.en: The speed limit on this highway is one hundred kilometers per hour.
examples.zh: 這條高速公路的速限是每小時一百公里。

examples.en: We hiked for several kilometers before reaching the mountain peak.
examples.zh: 我們徒步走了幾公里才到達山頂。

examples.en: A kilometer is equivalent to one thousand meters.
examples.zh: 一公里等於一千公尺。

examples.en: Make sure you tie a tight knot so the boat doesn't drift away.
examples.zh: 務必打個緊結，以免船漂走。

examples.en: She struggled to untie the knot in her shoelaces.
examples.zh: 她費力地解開鞋帶上的結。

examples.en: His stomach tied in a knot before he gave the speech.
examples.zh: 他在演講前緊張得胃揪成一團。

examples.en: The boy learned how to knot a tie from his father.
examples.zh: 男孩從父親那裡學會了如何打領帶。

examples.en: You need to master several basic knots for sailing.
examples.zh: 為了航海，你需要掌握幾個基本的繩結。

meaning: 隨手丟棄的垃圾；隨手亂丟垃圾

examples.en: People who leave litter in the park should be fined heavily.
examples.zh: 在公園裡亂丟垃圾的人應該受到重罰。

examples.en: Please use the trash cans and do not litter on the streets.
examples.zh: 請使用垃圾桶，不要在街上亂丟垃圾。

examples.en: The beach was covered with plastic bottles and other litter.
examples.zh: 海灘上佈滿了塑膠瓶和其他隨手丟棄的垃圾。

examples.en: The sign clearly reminds visitors not to litter the camping area.
examples.zh: 標誌清楚地提醒遊客不要在露營區亂丟垃圾。

examples.en: A group of volunteers spent the morning picking up litter along the river.
examples.zh: 一群志工花了一個上午在河岸邊撿垃圾。

examples.en: Drinking excessive alcohol can cause severe damage to your liver.
examples.zh: 過度飲酒會對你的肝臟造成嚴重損害。

examples.en: The liver is the largest internal organ in the human body.
examples.zh: 肝臟人體內最大的內部器官。

examples.en: She was diagnosed with a rare liver disease and needs a transplant.
examples.zh: 她被診斷出患有罕見的肝病，需要進行移植。

examples.en: Certain medications must be processed by the liver.
examples.zh: 某些藥物必須由肝臟處理。

examples.en: Eating a balanced diet helps keep your liver functioning properly.
examples.zh: 均衡飲食有助於保持肝臟正常運作。

examples.en: Smoking is one of the leading causes of lung cancer.
examples.zh: 抽菸是肺癌的主要原因之一。

examples.en: He took a deep breath, filling his lungs with fresh mountain air.
examples.zh: 他深吸了一口氣，讓肺部充滿新鮮的山區空氣。

examples.en: The doctor listened carefully to her lungs with a stethoscope.
examples.zh: 醫生用聽診器仔細聽她的肺部。

examples.en: Regular aerobic exercise can significantly improve your lung capacity.
examples.zh: 規律的有氧運動可以顯著改善你的肺活量。

examples.en: The infection spread to his right lung, causing severe coughing.
examples.zh: 感染蔓延到他的右肺，引起嚴重的咳嗽。

examples.en: We spent the entire afternoon shopping at the new mall.
examples.zh: 我們整個下午都在新購物中心逛街。

examples.en: The mall features a large cinema and various restaurants.
examples.zh: 這家購物中心設有大型電影院和各種餐廳。

examples.en: Teenagers often hang out with their friends at the mall.
examples.zh: 青少年經常和朋友在購物中心閒逛。

examples.en: Parking at the mall can be quite difficult on weekends.
examples.zh: 週末在購物中心停車可能會相當困難。

examples.en: They opened a small clothing boutique in the local mall.
examples.zh: 他們在當地的購物中心開了一家小型服裝精品店。

examples.en: The chef prepared a marvelous feast for the wedding guests.
examples.zh: 廚師為婚禮賓客準備了一場極好的盛宴。

examples.en: We had a marvelous time exploring the ancient ruins in Rome.
examples.zh: 我們在探索羅馬古蹟時度過了令人驚嘆的美好時光。

examples.en: What a marvelous idea it is to host a surprise party for him!
examples.zh: 為他舉辦驚喜派對真是個極好的主意！

examples.en: The view of the city from the top of the tower is simply marvelous.
examples.zh: 從塔頂俯瞰城市的景色簡直令人驚嘆。

examples.en: She did a marvelous job organizing the charity event all by herself.
examples.zh: 她獨自一人把這場慈善活動組織得極好。

examples.en: He proudly displayed the gold medal he won at the Olympics.
examples.zh: 他驕傲地展示他在奧運會上贏得的金牌。

examples.en: The soldier was awarded a medal of honor for his bravery in battle.
examples.zh: 這名士兵因在戰鬥中的英勇表現而被授予榮譽勳章。

examples.en: She came in second place and received a silver medal.
examples.zh: 她獲得了第二名並獲得了一枚銀牌。

examples.en: The marathon finishers were all given a commemorative medal.
examples.zh: 馬拉松完賽者都獲得了一枚紀念獎牌。

examples.en: Her dream is to earn a medal in the upcoming swimming championship.
examples.zh: 她的夢想是在即將到來的游泳錦標賽中贏得獎牌。

examples.en: We wish you a merry Christmas and a happy New Year.
examples.zh: 我們祝你聖誕快樂，新年快樂。

examples.en: The children's merry laughter echoed through the playground.
examples.zh: 孩子們歡樂的笑聲在遊樂場迴盪。

examples.en: They had a merry evening singing and dancing around the campfire.
examples.zh: 他們在營火旁唱歌跳舞，度過了一個愉快的夜晚。

examples.en: After a few glasses of wine, he became quite merry and talkative.
examples.zh: 喝了幾杯酒後，他變得相當愉快且健談。

examples.en: The villagers organized a merry celebration for the successful harvest.
examples.zh: 村民們為豐收舉辦了一場歡樂的慶祝活動。

examples.en: The little girl wanted to ride the merry-go-round one more time.
examples.zh: 小女孩想再坐一次旋轉木馬。

examples.en: The colorful horses on the merry-go-round moved up and down to the music.
examples.zh: 旋轉木馬上色彩鮮豔的馬匹隨著音樂上下移動。

examples.en: He feels like his busy life is a never-ending merry-go-round.
examples.zh: 他覺得自己忙碌的生活就像永無止境的旋轉木馬。

examples.en: The carnival featured a giant Ferris wheel and a vintage merry-go-round.
examples.zh: 嘉年華設有巨大的摩天輪和復古的旋轉木馬。

examples.en: She waved to her parents as the merry-go-round spun around.
examples.zh: 旋轉木馬轉動時，她向父母揮手。

examples.en: The athlete broke the world record in the 100-meter dash.
examples.zh: 這名運動員打破了100公尺短跑的世界紀錄。

examples.en: Please insert coins into the parking meter before you leave.
examples.zh: 離開前請將硬幣投入停車計時器。

examples.en: The fabric is sold by the meter at the local market.
examples.zh: 這布料在當地市場是按公尺出售的。

examples.en: The taxi driver turned on the meter as soon as we got in the car.
examples.zh: 我們一上車，計程車司機就打開了計程表。

examples.en: He installed a smart meter to monitor the household's electricity usage.
examples.zh: 他安裝了一個智慧電表來監控家庭的用電量。

examples.en: A millimeter is one-thousandth of a meter.
examples.zh: 一公厘是一公尺的千分之一。

examples.en: The thickness of this paper is about one millimeter.
examples.zh: 這張紙的厚度大約是一公厘。

examples.en: The surgeon made a small incision of only a few millimeters.
examples.zh: 外科醫生切開了一個只有幾公厘的小切口。

examples.en: Rainfall is often measured in millimeters.
examples.zh: 降雨量通常以公厘來測量。

examples.en: The gap between the doors was less than a millimeter.
examples.zh: 兩扇門之間的縫隙不到一公厘。

examples.en: The country successfully test-fired a new long-range missile.
examples.zh: 該國成功試射了一枚新型長程飛彈。

examples.en: The missile was intercepted before it could reach its target.
examples.zh: 這枚飛彈在擊中目標前就被攔截了。

examples.en: They are developing advanced missile defense systems.
examples.zh: 他們正在開發先進的飛彈防禦系統。

examples.en: The submarine is capable of launching nuclear missiles.
examples.zh: 這艘潛艇有能力發射核子飛彈。

examples.en: The sudden missile attack caused widespread panic in the city.
examples.zh: 突如其來的飛彈攻擊在城市中引起了廣泛的恐慌。

examples.en: Excuse me, mister, could you tell me the time?
examples.zh: 打擾一下，先生，請問能告訴我現在幾點嗎？

examples.en: The little boy politely said, 'Thank you, mister.'
examples.zh: 小男孩有禮貌地說：「謝謝你，先生。」

examples.en: Hey mister, you dropped your wallet on the ground.
examples.zh: 嘿，先生，你的錢包掉在地上了。

examples.en: She asked the mister at the front desk for some directions.
examples.zh: 她向前台的先生詢問方向。

examples.en: A friendly mister helped the elderly woman cross the street.
examples.zh: 一位友善的先生幫助老太太過馬路。

examples.en: We drove all day and finally stopped at a cheap motel for the night.
examples.zh: 我們開了一整天的車，最後在一家便宜的汽車旅館停下來過夜。

examples.en: The motel is conveniently located right next to the highway.
examples.zh: 這家汽車旅館交通便利，就在高速公路旁。

examples.en: Our motel room had a small television and a coffee maker.
examples.zh: 我們的汽車旅館房間裡有一台小電視和一台咖啡機。

examples.en: They decided to book a motel instead of a fancy hotel to save money.
examples.zh: 他們決定預訂汽車旅館而不是高級飯店，以節省開銷。

examples.en: The neon sign of the motel flickered in the darkness.
examples.zh: 汽車旅館的霓虹燈招牌在黑暗中閃爍。

examples.en: The washing machine stopped working because the motor broke down.
examples.zh: 洗衣機停止運轉，因為馬達故障了。

examples.en: He replaced the old motor in his boat with a more powerful one.
examples.zh: 他把船上的舊發動機換成了一個更強勁的。

examples.en: Electric motors are widely used in many household appliances.
examples.zh: 電動馬達廣泛應用於許多家用電器中。

examples.en: The engineer designed a highly efficient motor for the new drone.
examples.zh: 工程師為新型無人機設計了一款高效能馬達。

examples.en: We could hear the hum of the motor running in the background.
examples.zh: 我們可以聽到背景中馬達運轉的嗡嗡聲。

examples.en: In the sentence 'The cat sleeps', 'cat' is a noun.
examples.zh: 在句子「這隻貓在睡覺」中，「貓」是一個名詞。

examples.en: A proper noun always begins with a capital letter.
examples.zh: 專有名詞總是首字母大寫。

examples.en: Many English words can function as both a noun and a verb.
examples.zh: 許多英文單字既可以當名詞也可以當動詞。

examples.en: The teacher asked the students to underline all the nouns in the paragraph.
examples.zh: 老師要求學生在段落中畫出所有名詞的底線。

examples.en: Countable nouns refer to things that can be counted.
examples.zh: 可數名詞指的是可以被計算的事物。

examples.en: She drops her child off at the nursery before going to work.
examples.zh: 她上班前把孩子送到托兒所。

examples.en: The nursery is filled with young fruit trees and colorful flowers.
examples.zh: 這家苗圃裡種滿了幼小的果樹和五顏六色的花朵。

examples.en: Working at a plant nursery requires a lot of gardening knowledge.
examples.zh: 在植物苗圃工作需要許多園藝知識。

examples.en: The local nursery provides excellent care and education for toddlers.
examples.zh: 當地的托兒所為幼兒提供優質的照護和教育。

examples.en: He bought some rose bushes from the nearby nursery.
examples.zh: 他從附近的苗圃買了一些玫瑰花叢。

examples.en: These outdoor jackets are made of durable and waterproof nylon.
examples.zh: 這些戶外夾克是由耐用且防水的尼龍製成。

examples.en: Nylon strings are often used for classical guitars.
examples.zh: 尼龍弦常被用於古典吉他。

examples.en: She bought a pair of sheer nylon stockings for the formal event.
examples.zh: 她為了正式場合買了一雙薄透的尼龍絲襪。

examples.en: The invention of nylon revolutionized the textile industry.
examples.zh: 尼龍的發明徹底改變了紡織工業。

examples.en: A sturdy nylon backpack is perfect for hiking trips.
examples.zh: 堅固的尼龍背包非常適合徒步旅行。

examples.en: They bought tickets to see a classic Italian opera at the theater.
examples.zh: 他們買了票去劇院看一齣經典的義大利歌劇。

examples.en: She has an amazing voice and dreams of becoming an opera singer.
examples.zh: 她有著驚人的嗓音，夢想成為一名歌劇歌手。

examples.en: The Sydney Opera House is one of the most famous buildings in the world.
examples.zh: 雪梨歌劇院是世界上最著名的建築之一。

examples.en: He finds traditional opera a bit difficult to understand without subtitles.
examples.zh: 他覺得如果沒有字幕，傳統歌劇有點難以理解。

examples.en: The opera ended with a tragic and emotional finale.
examples.zh: 這齣歌劇以悲劇且感人的結局收場。

examples.en: She placed a soft pad under her knees while gardening.
examples.zh: 她做園藝時在膝蓋下放了一個軟墊。

examples.en: The goalkeeper wears special pads to protect his legs.
examples.zh: 守門員戴著特殊的護墊來保護腿部。

examples.en: I always keep a writing pad on my desk for taking quick notes.
examples.zh: 我總是在桌上放一本便條紙墊以便快速記筆記。

examples.en: He put a heating pad on his back to relieve the muscle pain.
examples.zh: 他在背上放了一個熱敷墊來緩解肌肉疼痛。

examples.en: Make sure the mouse pad is clean so the mouse can move smoothly.
examples.zh: 確保滑鼠墊是乾淨的，這樣滑鼠才能順暢移動。

examples.en: A penny saved is a penny earned.
examples.zh: 省一分錢就是賺一分錢。

examples.en: It didn't cost him a single penny to download the app.
examples.zh: 下載這個應用程式沒有花他一分錢。

examples.en: She found a shiny new penny on the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 她在人行道上發現了一枚閃亮的新便士。

examples.en: The old man is so poor that he doesn't have a penny to his name.
examples.zh: 那位老人窮得身無分文。

examples.en: I wouldn't give a penny for his terrible advice.
examples.zh: 我一分錢也不會為他那糟糕的建議付帳。

examples.en: It is a great pity that you can't come to the party tonight.
examples.zh: 你今晚不能來參加派對真是太可惜了。

examples.en: She felt a deep sense of pity for the starving children.
examples.zh: 她對那些挨餓的孩子感到深深的同情。

examples.en: Out of pity, he gave the homeless man some warm clothes.
examples.zh: 出於同情，他給了那個無家可歸的人一些保暖衣物。

examples.en: I pity anyone who has to work outside in this heavy storm.
examples.zh: 我同情任何必須在這場暴風雨中在戶外工作的人。

examples.en: What a pity that they lost the final match by just one point!
examples.zh: 他們在決賽中僅以一分之差落敗，真是可惜！

examples.en: He looked at his beautiful garden with a great sense of pride.
examples.zh: 他帶著極大的自豪感看著他美麗的花園。

examples.en: She takes pride in her ability to speak three languages fluently.
examples.zh: 她為自己能流利地說三種語言的能力感到自豪。

examples.en: His foolish pride prevented him from asking for help.
examples.zh: 他愚蠢的驕傲使他不願尋求幫助。

examples.en: The team's victory brought pride to the entire school.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍的勝利為全校帶來了榮耀。

examples.en: Swallow your pride and admit that you made a mistake.
examples.zh: 放下你的自尊，承認你犯了錯吧。

examples.en: In grammar, a pronoun is used to replace a noun.
examples.zh: 在文法中，代名詞用來代替名詞。

examples.en: Examples of personal pronouns include 'he', 'she', and 'they'.
examples.zh: 人稱代名詞的例子包括「他」、「她」和「他們」。

examples.en: Using pronouns helps avoid repeating the same noun over and over.
examples.zh: 使用代名詞有助於避免不斷重複同一個名詞。

examples.en: The pronoun 'it' usually refers to an animal or an object.
examples.zh: 代名詞「it」通常指動物或物體。

examples.en: Make sure the pronoun agrees with the noun it refers to in gender and number.
examples.zh: 確保代名詞在性別和數量上與它所指代的名詞一致。

examples.en: We need a bicycle pump to inflate these flat tires.
examples.zh: 我們需要一個自行車打氣筒來把這些癟輪胎打氣。

examples.en: The heart acts as a pump to circulate blood throughout the body.
examples.zh: 心臟就像一個幫浦，使血液在全身循環。

examples.en: They had to pump water out of the flooded basement all night.
examples.zh: 他們整晚都得把淹水地下室裡的水抽出來。

examples.en: He stopped at the gas station to pump some fuel into his car.
examples.zh: 他在加油站停下來為他的車加油（打氣）。

examples.en: She pumped up the air mattress before the guests arrived.
examples.zh: 客房抵達前，她把充氣床墊打滿了氣。

examples.en: He picked up the phone receiver as soon as it rang.
examples.zh: 電話一響他就拿起了話筒。

examples.en: The letter was returned because the receiver's address was incorrect.
examples.zh: 信件被退回，因為收件人的地址不正確。

examples.en: The quarterback threw a perfect pass to the wide receiver.
examples.zh: 四分衛傳了一個完美的球給外接手（接球員）。

examples.en: Our TV receiver seems to be broken; there is no signal.
examples.zh: 我們的電視接收器似乎壞了；沒有訊號。

examples.en: Make sure you slam the receiver down gently when hanging up.
examples.zh: 掛斷電話時，請務必輕輕放下話筒。

examples.en: The journalist used a voice recorder during the interview.
examples.zh: 記者在採訪時使用了一台錄音機。

examples.en: Many students learn how to play the recorder in elementary school music class.
examples.zh: 許多學生在小學音樂課上學習吹直笛。

examples.en: The flight data recorder was recovered from the airplane crash site.
examples.zh: 飛行資料記錄器已從墜機現場尋獲。

examples.en: He set the video recorder to tape his favorite TV show while he was out.
examples.zh: 他把錄影機設定好，在出門時錄下他最喜歡的電視節目。

examples.en: Please turn on the recorder so we can document this meeting.
examples.zh: 請打開錄音機，以便我們記錄這次會議。

examples.en: They sought refuge in a nearby church during the heavy storm.
examples.zh: 在一場大風暴中，他們在附近的教堂尋求避難。

examples.en: The national park serves as a wildlife refuge for endangered animals.
examples.zh: 這座國家公園是瀕臨絕種動物的野生動物保護區。

examples.en: Many people fled across the border to find refuge from the war.
examples.zh: 許多人逃越邊境，以躲避戰爭尋求庇護。

examples.en: Reading books is her ultimate refuge from the stress of daily life.
examples.zh: 閱讀書籍是她逃避日常壓力的最終避風港。

examples.en: The homeless shelter provides a safe refuge for those in need.
examples.zh: 無家可歸者收容所為有需要的人提供了一個安全的避難所。

examples.en: The government has set up camps to accommodate the incoming refugees.
examples.zh: 政府已經設立營地來安置湧入的難民。

examples.en: Many refugees were forced to leave their homes because of the civil war.
examples.zh: 許多難民因為內戰而被迫離開家園。

examples.en: The charity organization provides food and medical care for the refugees.
examples.zh: 該慈善機構為難民提供食物和醫療照護。

examples.en: As a refugee, he faced many challenges starting a new life in a foreign country.
examples.zh: 身為一名難民，他在異國開始新生活面臨了許多挑戰。

examples.en: The international community is trying to find a solution to the refugee crisis.
examples.zh: 國際社會正在努力尋找解決難民危機的方法。

examples.en: She tied a beautiful red ribbon around the birthday present.
examples.zh: 她在生日禮物上綁了一條美麗的紅緞帶。

examples.en: The little girl wore a pink ribbon in her hair.
examples.zh: 小女孩的頭髮上戴著一條粉紅色緞帶。

examples.en: The mayor cut the ribbon to officially open the new hospital.
examples.zh: 市長剪綵正式啟用新醫院。

examples.en: A blue ribbon is often awarded as a symbol of first place in a competition.
examples.zh: 藍絲帶通常被授予作為比賽第一名的象徵。

examples.en: He bought a spool of silk ribbon for her crafting project.
examples.zh: 他買了一軸絲帶讓她做手工藝計畫。

examples.en: Two armed men tried to rob the local bank yesterday.
examples.zh: 兩名武裝男子昨天試圖搶劫當地銀行。

examples.en: The poor lighting on this street makes it easy for criminals to rob pedestrians.
examples.zh: 這條街照明不佳，使得罪犯很容易搶劫行人。

examples.en: He was robbed of his wallet and phone while walking home late at night.
examples.zh: 他在深夜走回家時被搶走了錢包和手機。

examples.en: The injury robbed the young athlete of his chance to compete in the finals.
examples.zh: 這場傷病剝奪了這位年輕運動員參加決賽的機會。

examples.en: They planned to rob the jewelry store but were caught by the police.
examples.zh: 他們計畫搶劫珠寶店，但被警察抓住了。

examples.en: The bank robber was wearing a mask to hide his face.
examples.zh: 銀行搶匪戴著面具以掩蓋臉部。

examples.en: The brave shop owner fought off the armed robber.
examples.zh: 勇敢的店主擊退了持槍強盜。

examples.en: Police are still searching for the robbers who broke into the museum.
examples.zh: 警方仍在尋找闖入博物館的搶匪。

examples.en: The robber demanded all the cash in the register.
examples.zh: 搶匪要求交出收銀機裡所有的現金。

examples.en: He was sentenced to ten years in prison for being a notorious robber.
examples.zh: 他因為是一名惡名昭彰的搶匪而被判處十年徒刑。

examples.en: The detective is investigating an armed robbery at the convenience store.
examples.zh: 偵探正在調查便利商店的一起持械搶劫案。

examples.en: He was arrested and charged with attempted robbery.
examples.zh: 他被逮捕並被指控企圖搶劫。

examples.en: The frequency of bank robberies in the city has decreased significantly.
examples.zh: 該城市銀行搶劫案的發生率已顯著下降。

examples.en: They witnessed the robbery and quickly called the police.
examples.zh: 他們目擊了搶劫過程並迅速報了警。

examples.en: The total amount of money stolen during the robbery was huge.
examples.zh: 在搶劫中被盜的總金額非常龐大。

examples.en: After taking a hot shower, he wrapped himself in a thick cotton robe.
examples.zh: 洗完熱水澡後，他裹上了一件厚棉浴袍。

examples.en: The judge entered the courtroom wearing a long black robe.
examples.zh: 法官穿著黑色長袍走進法庭。

examples.en: The wizard in the story wore a purple robe covered in silver stars.
examples.zh: 故事裡的巫師穿著一件布滿銀星的紫色長袍。

examples.en: She bought a luxurious silk robe as a gift for her mother.
examples.zh: 她買了一件奢華的絲綢長袍作為送給母親的禮物。

examples.en: The choir members put on their red robes before the performance.
examples.zh: 合唱團成員在表演前穿上了他們的紅色長袍。

meaning: 火箭；一飛衝天、急速上升

examples.en: The space agency successfully launched a new rocket into orbit.
examples.zh: 太空機構成功發射了一枚新火箭進入軌道。

examples.en: Fuel prices have rocketed recently due to the global shortage.
examples.zh: 由於全球短缺，燃料價格最近急遽上升。

examples.en: The boy was fascinated by the model rocket and dreamed of being an astronaut.
examples.zh: 男孩對模型火箭非常著迷，夢想成為太空人。

examples.en: Sales of the new smartphone rocketed on the first day of its release.
examples.zh: 新款智慧型手機在發布首日的銷量一飛衝天。

examples.en: The rocket booster separated from the main ship as planned.
examples.zh: 火箭推進器按計畫從主船體分離。

examples.en: She served the hot coffee in a delicate cup and saucer.
examples.zh: 她用精緻的杯子和茶碟端上熱咖啡。

examples.en: The cat happily licked the milk from the small saucer on the floor.
examples.zh: 那隻貓開心地舔著地板上小碟子裡的牛奶。

examples.en: Be careful not to spill tea into the saucer.
examples.zh: 小心不要把茶灑到托盤裡。

examples.en: Many people reported seeing a flying saucer in the night sky.
examples.zh: 許多人報告說在夜空中看到了飛碟（飛行的托盤）。

examples.en: The antique store sells a matching set of teacups and saucers.
examples.zh: 這家古董店賣一整套相配的茶杯和茶碟。

meaning: 勺子、一勺的量；獨家新聞；舀出、挖出

examples.en: I would like two scoops of vanilla ice cream, please.
examples.zh: 請給我兩勺香草冰淇淋。

examples.en: He used a large plastic scoop to dig in the sand.
examples.zh: 他用一個大塑膠勺在沙子裡挖。

examples.en: The journalist was thrilled to get a major scoop on the scandal.
examples.zh: 記者很高興能獲得關於這樁醜聞的重大獨家新聞。

examples.en: She quickly scooped up the spilled sugar from the counter.
examples.zh: 她迅速地把灑在流理台上的糖舀起來。

examples.en: Can you scoop some flour into the mixing bowl for me?
examples.zh: 你能幫我舀一些麵粉到攪拌碗裡嗎？

examples.en: You need a screwdriver to tighten this loose screw.
examples.zh: 你需要一把螺絲起子來鎖緊這個鬆動的螺絲釘。

examples.en: Please make sure to screw the lid tightly on the jar.
examples.zh: 請務必把罐子的蓋子旋緊。

examples.en: He forgot to put a screw in the hinge, so the door doesn't close properly.
examples.zh: 他忘了在鉸鏈上裝螺絲，所以門關不緊。

examples.en: They had to screw the wooden boards together to build the fence.
examples.zh: 他們必須用螺絲把木板鎖在一起來建造圍欄。

examples.en: Be careful not to screw up this important project.
examples.zh: 小心別搞砸了這個重要的專案。（俚語用法）

examples.en: He used a flathead screwdriver to open the paint can.
examples.zh: 他用一把平頭螺絲起子打開油漆罐。

examples.en: Could you pass me the Phillips screwdriver to fix this chair?
examples.zh: 你能把十字螺絲起子遞給我來修這把椅子嗎？

examples.en: Always keep a basic toolkit with a hammer and a screwdriver at home.
examples.zh: 家裡總是該備有一個包含鐵鎚和螺絲起子的基本工具箱。

examples.en: An electric screwdriver can save you a lot of time and effort.
examples.zh: 電動螺絲起子可以為你省下許多時間和力氣。

examples.en: The mechanic reached for his screwdriver to adjust the engine.
examples.zh: 技工伸手去拿螺絲起子來調整引擎。

examples.en: I need to buy a new bottle of shampoo for dry hair.
examples.zh: 我需要買一瓶新的乾性髮質適用洗髮精。

examples.en: She always shampoos her hair every other day to keep it healthy.
examples.zh: 為了保持健康，她總是每隔一天洗一次頭髮。

examples.en: The hotel provides free soap, shampoo, and towels for guests.
examples.zh: 飯店為客人提供免費的肥皂、洗髮精和毛巾。

examples.en: Make sure you rinse all the shampoo out of your hair thoroughly.
examples.zh: 確保你徹底沖洗掉頭髮上所有的洗髮精。

examples.en: He is allergic to the strong fragrance in this cheap shampoo.
examples.zh: 他對這款廉價洗髮精裡強烈的香味過敏。

examples.en: My grandmother loves watching daily soap operas on television.
examples.zh: 我祖母喜歡看電視上每天播出的肥皂劇。

examples.en: The plot of this soap opera is incredibly dramatic and unrealistic.
examples.zh: 這齣肥皂劇的情節極度戲劇化且不切實際。

examples.en: He acts as the main villain in a popular Spanish soap opera.
examples.zh: 他在一部受歡迎的西班牙肥皂劇中扮演主要反派角色。

examples.en: Soap operas are known for their exaggerated storylines and emotional conflicts.
examples.zh: 肥皂劇以其誇張的故事情節和情感衝突而聞名。

examples.en: She never misses an episode of her favorite evening soap opera.
examples.zh: 她從不錯過她最喜歡的晚間肥皂劇的任何一集。

examples.en: He expressed his deep sorrow over the loss of his beloved pet.
examples.zh: 他對失去心愛的寵物表達了深深的悲傷。

examples.en: Her eyes were filled with sorrow as she listened to the tragic news.
examples.zh: 當她聽到這個悲慘的消息時，眼中充滿了憂傷。

examples.en: Time slowly heals the sorrow of losing a loved one.
examples.zh: 時間會慢慢治癒失去摯愛的悲痛。

examples.en: They shared both the joys and sorrows of their long marriage.
examples.zh: 他們分享了漫長婚姻中的快樂與悲傷。

examples.en: The sad melody perfectly captures the sorrow of a broken heart.
examples.zh: 這悲傷的旋律完美捕捉了心碎的憂傷。

examples.en: The guest speaker at the conference delivered an inspiring presentation.
examples.zh: 會議上的客座演講者發表了一場激勵人心的演講。

examples.en: I need to connect my phone to the Bluetooth speaker to play music.
examples.zh: 我需要將手機連接到藍牙揚聲器來播放音樂。

examples.en: He is a fluent speaker of both English and French.
examples.zh: 他是一個能流利使用英語和法語的人。

examples.en: The sound quality from this small portable speaker is surprisingly good.
examples.zh: 這個小型便攜式揚聲器的音質出奇的好。

examples.en: The audience applauded loudly when the speaker finished his speech.
examples.zh: 當演講者結束演講時，觀眾大聲鼓掌。

examples.en: He works as a secret spy for the national intelligence agency.
examples.zh: 他作為國家情報局的秘密間諜工作。

examples.en: They suspect that an enemy spy has infiltrated the military base.
examples.zh: 他們懷疑有一名敵方間諜潛入了軍事基地。

examples.en: The neighbor likes to spy on everyone through his window.
examples.zh: 那個鄰居喜歡透過窗戶暗中監視大家。

examples.en: A spy movie is full of action, deception, and advanced gadgets.
examples.zh: 間諜電影充滿了動作、欺騙和先進的裝備。

examples.en: She was caught trying to spy on her competitor's business plans.
examples.zh: 她被抓到試圖刺探競爭對手的商業計畫。

meaning: 體育場；露天大型運動場

examples.en: The national football team will play their next match at the city stadium.
examples.zh: 國家足球隊將在市立體育場進行下一場比賽。

examples.en: Tens of thousands of fans filled the stadium to watch the final game.
examples.zh: 數以萬計的球迷擠滿了體育場觀看決賽。

examples.en: They are building a massive new stadium for the upcoming Olympic Games.
examples.zh: 他們正在為即將到來的奧運會建造一座巨大的新體育場。

examples.en: The cheers from the crowd echoed throughout the entire stadium.
examples.zh: 人群的歡呼聲在整個露天體育場迴盪。

examples.en: We bought tickets in the front row of the stadium for a better view.
examples.zh: 我們買了體育場前排的票以獲得更好的視野。

examples.en: He sat on a tall wooden stool at the bar and ordered a drink.
examples.zh: 他坐在酒吧的高腳木凳上點了一杯飲料。

examples.en: The little boy stood on a step stool to reach the cookie jar.
examples.zh: 小男孩站在墊腳凳上拿餅乾罐。

examples.en: The doctor asked the patient to provide a stool sample for medical testing.
examples.zh: 醫生要求病人提供糞便樣本進行醫學檢驗。

examples.en: She pushed the small stool under the table to save space.
examples.zh: 她把小凳子推到桌下以節省空間。

examples.en: A three-legged stool is often more stable on uneven ground.
examples.zh: 在不平坦的地面上，三條腿的凳子通常更穩定。

examples.en: Please throw your empty plastic bottles into the trash can.
examples.zh: 請將你喝空的塑膠瓶扔進垃圾桶。

examples.en: The park was completely covered in trash after the outdoor festival.
examples.zh: 戶外音樂節過後，公園裡滿地都是垃圾。

examples.en: I can't believe you watch that reality show; it's absolute trash.
examples.zh: 我真不敢相信你看那個實境秀；那根本是垃圾。

examples.en: He took out the trash on his way to work this morning.
examples.zh: 他今天早上上班途中把垃圾拿出去倒了。

examples.en: Don't listen to his complaints; he's just talking trash.
examples.zh: 別聽他的抱怨；他只是在說廢話。

examples.en: Most of the residents in this neighborhood are white-collar professionals.
examples.zh: 這個社區的大多數居民都是白領專業人士。

examples.en: White-collar crimes, such as fraud, are often difficult to investigate.
examples.zh: 白領犯罪（如詐欺）通常很難調查。

examples.en: He left his physically demanding job for a comfortable white-collar position.
examples.zh: 他離開了需要體力的工作，轉向舒適的白領職位。

examples.en: White-collar workers typically spend long hours sitting at their desks.
examples.zh: 白領工作者通常長時間坐在辦公桌前。

examples.en: The company offers excellent benefits to attract highly skilled white-collar employees.
examples.zh: 這家公司提供優厚的福利以吸引高技能的白領員工。
